decisions.reason: GA4 is the current analytics standard in 2024 and a tracking plugin fits the firm's core e-commerce implementation and support business.
Universal Analytics is obsolete after Google's phase-out, so continuing a dedicated UA plugin would have little market demand and weak strategic value.
A retail system interface plugin matches the firm's integration capabilities and can support client shop operations, even if it may remain a niche product.
SEO support for shop relaunches is a natural complement to the firm's relaunch, marketing, and conversion services and was prominent enough to merit its own page.
